newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens industry unit new orders slip.
newsitem.headline: Siemens industry unit new orders slip.

text.p: German industrial and electronics giant Siemens AG said on Monday that its industry division saw a fall in new orders in the first five months of 1996/97 to 10.2 billion marks from 10.4 billion.
Sales in the five months to the end of September were up one percent at 7.7 billion marks, Siemens management board member Edward Krubasik said at the Hanover Industry Trade Fair.
The fall in new orders reflected a flattening in previously above-average growth, Krubasik said, but the outlook for the industry division was very good.
In 1995/96 the industry division reported new orders of 25.6 billion marks, an increase of 6.7 percent on the previous year. Sales in 1995/96 grew five percent to 24.7 billion marks.
